environment.description: AWS Lambda function (Python 3.11 runtime) deployed via SAM template in us-east-1. The function is exposed through an internal ALB (scheme: internal) within a VPC. The ALB target group has no additional filtering. The Lambda function runs with a basic execution role (AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole). Network: VPC with private subnets, but all services within the VPC can reach the ALB on port 443. No service mesh is deployed. The function has 512MB memory and 30s timeout. CloudWatch logging is enabled but no request-level timing analysis or anomaly detection is configured.

config.network: VPC private subnets, all internal services can reach ALB
